lines.text: Many learners say: Can you borrow me a pen?
Better: Can you lend me a pen?
Lend means give for a while.
Lend! Can you lend me a pen?

data.wrong: Can you borrow me a pen?
data.right: Can you lend me a pen?
data.why: Lend means give for a while.

native.tip: 빌려줄 때는 lend! 빌릴 때는 borrow예요. “Can you lend me a pen?”

en.tip: Lend means give for a while. Borrow means take. Say “lend me a pen”.
en.caption: Do you say “Can you borrow me a pen?”? 😅 Lend is giving, borrow is taking. Here you want them to give. “Can you lend me a pen?” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
